prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. CACE N5 school vocabulary stimulus. ONE square image, one scene, pure white seamless background, only the named referents and indispensable support, no bystanders or unrelated objects. Entire composition centered in central 70 percent with broad white margin ALL sides; whole figures and objects, correct natural anatomy, friendly and suitable for primary school. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos, labels, symbols, watermark or collage. Make the exact spatial/possession/content relation visually unambiguous. Medium: friendly flat 2D educational drawing, no 3D. Exact target BALENA + FORA + GOT. One friendly recognizable whale resting in a tiny bounded patch of water clearly OUTSIDE one empty transparent drinking glass. Whale separated from glass by a visible gap, whole body including flippers and tail beyond glass walls. Entire glass rim and base visible and empty. Whimsical whale larger than glass, not stranded or distressed, no other props, no printed whale motif. Only whale, essential small water patch and empty glass, broad margins.
